description: This file contains implementation code for a server component, specifically managing server lifecycle, signal handling, plugin interactions, instance spawning, state management, and processing angel connections in a lighttpd-related environment.

classes.name: liServer
classes.description: Represents the server instance including event loop, signal watchers, and plugin management.

classes.name: liInstance
classes.description: Represents an individual server instance, managing its state, associated processes, and angel connections.

classes.name: liInstanceConf
classes.description: Configuration structure for creating server instances, including command, environment, user permissions, and resource limits.

classes.name: liInstanceResource
classes.description: Resources associated with server instances, with callback for freeing resources.

methods.name: void sigint_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback for handling SIGINT and SIGTERM signals, stops the server.

methods.name: void sigpipe_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback for handling SIGPIPE signals, intentionally ignored.

methods.name: liServer * li_server_new(const gchar * module_dir,gboolean module_resident)
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new server instance, setting up signal handlers and plugins.

methods.name: void li_server_free(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the server instance.

methods.name: void li_server_stop(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Stops the server by stopping signal watchers, plugins, and event loop.

methods.name: void instance_angel_call_cb(liAngelConnection * acon,const gchar * mod,gsize mod_len,const gchar * action,gsize action_len,gint32 id,GString * data)
methods.description: Handles an angel call for a plugin, executing the corresponding callback or sending an error.

methods.name: void instance_angel_close_cb(liAngelConnection * acon,GError * err)
methods.description: Handles closing of an angel connection, freeing resources and logging errors.

methods.name: void instance_child_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback invoked when a server instance child process terminates, handling cleanup and state updates.

methods.name: void instance_spawn_setup(gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Sets up file descriptors when spawning a new server instance.

methods.name: void instance_spawn(liInstance * i)
methods.description: Spawns a new server instance, establishing angel connection and process management.

methods.name: liInstance * li_server_new_instance(liServer * srv,liInstanceConf * ic)
methods.description: Creates a new server instance with provided configuration.

methods.name: gboolean li_instance_replace(liInstance * oldi,liInstance * newi)
methods.description: Replaces an existing server instance with a new one, establishing linking for replacement.

methods.name: void li_instance_unset_replace(liInstance * oldi,liInstance * newi)
methods.description: Unsets the replacement linkage between two instances and notifies plugins.

methods.name: void li_instance_set_state(liInstance * i,liInstanceState s)
methods.description: Transitions an instance to a specified state, spawning processes or sending commands as needed.

methods.name: void li_instance_state_reached(liInstance * i,liInstanceState s)
methods.description: Handles actions once a server instance reaches a specific state, including spawning, suspending, or finishing.

methods.name: void li_instance_release(liInstance * i)
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and frees an instance if no longer referenced.

methods.name: void li_instance_acquire(liInstance * i)
methods.description: Increments the reference count for an instance.

methods.name: liInstanceConf * li_instance_conf_new(gchar ** cmd,gchar ** env,GString * username,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile)
methods.description: Creates a new instance configuration with command, environment, user, and resource limits.

methods.name: void li_instance_conf_release(liInstanceConf * ic)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an instance configuration.

methods.name: void li_instance_conf_acquire(liInstanceConf * ic)
methods.description: Increments the reference count for an instance configuration.

methods.name: void li_instance_add_resource(liInstance * i,liInstanceResource * res,liInstanceResourceFreeCB free_cb,liPlugin * p,gpointer data)
methods.description: Attaches a resource to a server instance with a specified free callback.

methods.name: void li_instance_rem_resource(liInstance * i,liInstanceResource * res)
methods.description: Removes a resource from a server instance.

ctags.name: instance_angel_call_cb
ctags.signature: (liAngelConnection * acon,const gchar * mod,gsize mod_len,const gchar * action,gsize action_len,gint32 id,GString * data)

ctags.name: li_instance_conf_new
ctags.pattern: /^liInstanceConf* li_instance_conf_new(gchar **cmd, gchar **env, GString *username, uid_t uid, gid/
ctags.signature: (gchar ** cmd,gchar ** env,GString * username,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile)
